description:
Co-Invest brings Liquid market research and portfolio planning into ChatGPT.

Ask about crypto, equities, commodities, indices and prediction markets and get live prices, funding, positioning, technical indicators, charts and news. Review your Liquid portfolio, open orders and history, and model an allocation that fits your risk and time horizon.

When you want to act, Co-Invest prepares the trade and opens Liquid, our brokerage, with the idea ready for your final review; live orders are not placed from ChatGPT. A paper account with simulated funds lets you practice and manage simulated positions.

Designed for traders who want sharper context, faster planning, and a more connected way to navigate Liquid markets.

defaultPrompt: What moved NVDA in the last 24 hours?
Plan a moderate-risk portfolio across crypto, stocks and gold
Which prediction markets are open on Bitcoin and on upcoming Premier League matches? Show the odds.
